names: Church of Our Lady of the Rosary of Black Men (Ouro Preto)
Igreja de Nossa Senhora do Rosário dos Pretos
mapIdentity.scope: The 47-corner named OpenStreetMap way supplies the exterior perimeter. Its bowed front and square-facing end fix the model axis. Exact source coordinates accompany the footprint.

note: Municipal and heritage sources identify the unusual double oval, cylindrical towers, three entry arches, three upper balcony doors and a compound curved pediment. Local section sizes are estimated.
